messages:
Priya (PM): Morning — canary started but SRE flagged a memory spike on embeddings. Need to decide MVP cuts ASAP.
Ethan (Eng): Which deliverables are on the table?
Priya (PM): Options: cut the offline eval runner, cut the tenant metrics dashboard, or postpone prompt-router rules. Any combination buys us different timelines.
Tess (Design): We can ship a very small status panel instead of the full dashboard. Saves a bunch of design/dev cycles.
Ravi (SRE): The memory issue correlates with embeddings retention window. Offline eval runner keeps warm copies longer. Removing it drops expected staging memory by ~40%.
Marla (Sales): Pilot customers want visibility. If we cut dashboard, can we provide a manual telemetry export they can consume?
Priya (PM): Proposal: MVP = core inference + routing only. Move offline eval runner + advanced dashboard to v1. Offer CSV export for pilot telemetry. Decision by COB so legal/comms can update.
Ethan (Eng): I can tag the eval runner code and flip feature flags. If we keep it, ship slips by 2 sprints.
Ravi (SRE): I'll add a retention knob and an alert if embeddings memory > 70% during canary. That gives us a safe rollback path.
Tess (Design): I'll mock the minimal status panel and the in-app banner copy: "Full telemetry dashboard coming in v1. Exports available on request."
Marla (Sales): I'll get pilot opt-ins for the CSV export and ask them to sign the amendment that includes the v1 target date. They need the v1 date in writing.
Priya (PM): Proposed v1 target for dashboard+eval-runner: 2024-07-15. Approve? :calendar:
Ethan (Eng): :+1: sounds right.
Ravi (SRE): Approve, with staging alert and rollback flag.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2024-03-14T09:22:00Z initiated for rc-2024-03-14.
Priya (PM): Locking the cut. Action items: Ethan — PR to mark eval-runner v1; Ravi — add alert & retention knob; Tess — status panel mock + banner copy; Marla — customer amendment. I'll update the milestone board once PR merged.
Ethan (Eng): PR created: /docs/release/eval-runner-cut-1819999999.md
Ravi (SRE): Staging alert dashboard updated.
Marla (Sales): Two pilots signed the telemetry amendment.
Priya (PM): Thanks all. Closing thread — will post the updated roadmap snapshot in #product-updates.
